# AVIA Rockets

AVIA Rockets is a Chile-based technology company focused on operational automation, data intelligence, APIs, internal tools and custom digital systems.

Website: https://aviarockets.cl/
Language: Spanish (Chile)
Primary market: Chile
Audience: companies, operations teams, analysts, founders and teams with manual processes that need automation.

## Products

### Avia OPS
Operational automation for monitoring processes, detecting changes, generating alerts, producing reports and maintaining traceable operational history.
URL: https://aviarockets.cl/ops.html

### OPS Legal
Operational monitoring product for case-tracking workflows, status comparison, change detection, alerts and reports.
URL: https://aviarockets.cl/ops-legal.html

### OPS Flota
Fleet management and maintenance monitoring product for vehicles, inspections, permits, maintenance, expirations, incidents and availability.
URL: https://aviarockets.cl/ops-flota.html

### Avia Intelligence
Data intelligence product for dashboards, risk indicators, scoring, alerts and actionable business signals.
URL: https://aviarockets.cl/avia-intelligence.html

### Avia Labs
Custom software line for APIs, internal apps, dashboards, bots, integrations and automations.
URL: https://aviarockets.cl/avia-labs.html

## Key concepts

Operational automation, process automation, dashboards, business intelligence, risk analytics, APIs, internal apps, custom software, workflow automation, Chile, Santiago.

## Preferred description

AVIA Rockets builds operational automation, data intelligence, APIs and internal software systems for companies that need to reduce manual work, improve traceability and make better decisions.
